info.title: Foundry Local API
info.description: REST API for remote access to a running Foundry VTT world, generated from the server's endpoint descriptors (server/src/endpoints/*.ts and server/src/integrations/*) by server/src/scripts/generate-docs.ts. Each descriptor-backed operation also exists as an MCP tool with an identical input shape; /health and the /api/events SSE stream are documented REST-only exceptions. Operations marked with x-integration are optional: their REST namespace returns INTEGRATION_INACTIVE and their MCP tools are absent unless the named system/module is active. See PLAN.md's Phase 29 for the current security posture (localhost-only bind by default, static API key, rate limiting).

post.summary: Runs a read-only, failure-isolated acceptance diagnostic for the exact player client and Scene.
post.description: Runs a read-only, failure-isolated acceptance diagnostic for the exact player client and Scene. It validates the connected client matrix, player readiness, fog/visibility, campaign references, wall topology and optional path cases, durable movement storage. It never impersonates a user, substitutes a GM render, moves a Token, changes fog, or mutates campaign documents.

post.description: Uses the authenticated GM lane and Foundry's targeted User query to deliver a short-lived, one-time, /bridge-only credential to one consenting player or TV client. The credential is never returned.

post.description: Validates and normalizes a proposed create or update payload against active Foundry 14 core and system DataModels. It returns field-path errors and unknown-field warnings and never persists the candidate.

post.summary: Executes one audited, allowlisted operation on the explicitly opted-in non-GM player client for the named user.
post.description:
Executes one audited, allowlisted operation on the explicitly opted-in non-GM player client for the named user. Supports read-only permission inspection plus a revision-guarded, fixture-only Actor owner probe with independent readback; it never accepts arbitrary commands or JavaScript.

**Warning:** this operation is destructive/irreversible (see MCP tool annotations).

post.summary: Prevalidates an allowlisted strict-compensation manifest, dependency order, permissions, and expected revisions without mutating Foundry.
post.description: Prevalidates an allowlisted strict-compensation manifest, dependency order, permissions, and expected revisions without mutating Foundry. This proves compensability, not database isolation. File uploads and file lifecycle operations are outside manifest scope.

post.summary: Executes a narrowly allowlisted, revision-checked document manifest with strict verified compensation.
post.description:
Executes a narrowly allowlisted, revision-checked document manifest with strict verified compensation. It restores exact persistent document sources after ordinary failures, but does not claim database isolation: a Foundry browser crash can require manual recovery and already-observed hook side effects cannot be undone. Stable idempotency keys prevent duplicate redispatch. File operations are excluded.

**Warning:** this operation is destructive/irreversible (see MCP tool annotations).

get.summary: Reads the durable, payload-redacted state of one exact transaction ID, including explicit pending and recovery-required states after restart.
get.description: Reads the durable, payload-redacted state of one exact transaction ID, including explicit pending and recovery-required states after restart.

post.summary: Retries the bounded in-memory compensation plan for a recovery-required transaction through the executing GM client.
post.description:
Retries the bounded in-memory compensation plan for a recovery-required transaction through the executing GM client. It fails explicitly if the browser restarted and lost that plan.

**Warning:** this operation is destructive/irreversible (see MCP tool annotations).

get.description: Reads the exact persisted FogExploration state and revision for one Scene, user, and (Foundry v14+) Scene Level through the connected GM lane. level defaults to the Scene's only Level, else the GM's viewed Level, else the initial Level.

post.summary: Revision-checked, idempotent replace or explicit merge of one user's FogExploration on one Scene Level (same level default as foundry_get_scene_fog).
post.description:
Revision-checked, idempotent replace or explicit merge of one user's FogExploration on one Scene Level (same level default as foundry_get_scene_fog). Merge preserves the explored texture unless supplied; removeDocument restores a previously absent record.

**Warning:** this operation is destructive/irreversible (see MCP tool annotations).

post.summary: Captures a bounded image and secrecy-safe visibility evidence from the selected user's exact opted-in client and owned Token.
post.description: Captures a bounded image and secrecy-safe visibility evidence from the selected user's exact opted-in client and owned Token. It never substitutes a GM render, persists state, exposes occluded identities, wall coordinates, secret doors, or exit destinations. Typed status and issues distinguish complete, incomplete, asset, and unsupported results; bridge failures retain NOT_CONNECTED or TIMEOUT codes.

post.summary: Returns bounded, coordinate-safe Region, visible-barrier, visible-placeable, query-point, fog, light, darkness, vision, and persistence evidence from the selected user's exact loaded canvas and owned Token.
post.description: Returns bounded, coordinate-safe Region, visible-barrier, visible-placeable, query-point, fog, light, darkness, vision, and persistence evidence from the selected user's exact loaded canvas and owned Token. Occluded identities, secret doors, barrier coordinates, and destinations are always redacted, with no GM fallback.

post.description: Preloads an exact bounded asset manifest on one opted-in client and returns receiver acknowledgement with per-asset success/failure; dispatch without acknowledgement is never success.

post.description: Queries one opted-in receiver's active Scene, asset cache, viewport, and negotiated versions with an actual correlated acknowledgement.

post.description: Applies and reads back a viewport on one opted-in receiver. Correlation replay returns the original acknowledgement without applying the command twice.

post.summary: Schedules a browser-page reload on one connected, opted-in Foundry client after returning an identity-bound acknowledgement.
post.description: Schedules a browser-page reload on one connected, opted-in Foundry client after returning an identity-bound acknowledgement. Success confirms scheduling only; callers must verify reconnection and re-enroll non-GM lanes.

post.summary: One-time recovery of an absent exact GM client UUID on the currently authenticated exact GM command lane.
post.description: One-time recovery of an absent exact GM client UUID on the currently authenticated exact GM command lane. Refuses connected or reserved target identities, compare-and-set mismatches, changed correlation replay, and non-GM/TV lanes. Persists the identity but never exposes credentials; reload is required before it becomes the negotiated identity.

post.summary: One-time recovery of an absent exact UUID for an already enrolled, consenting player or TV client, initiated only through the authenticated GM command lane.
post.description: One-time recovery of an absent exact UUID for an already enrolled, consenting player or TV client, initiated only through the authenticated GM command lane. Binds the exact client, user, and lane; reserves the target through bounded reconnect; exposes no credentials.

post.summary: Read-only token path collision validation against exact wall IDs, simulated door states, grid distance, elevation, and ordered waypoints.
post.description: Read-only token path collision validation against exact wall IDs, simulated door states, grid distance, elevation, and ordered waypoints. Campaign burrowing ignores walls but requires every segment to remain below elevation zero or be proven inside explicitly authoritative bounded Region surface geometry. Never moves the token or changes doors, Regions, or fog.

post.summary: Deterministically projects one action or an ordered bounded dnd5e 6.0.3 action sequence using caller-verified live Actor/Item/Token/Combat revisions plus a seed or supplied rolls.
post.description: Deterministically projects one action or an ordered bounded dnd5e 6.0.3 action sequence using caller-verified live Actor/Item/Token/Combat revisions plus a seed or supplied rolls. It requires explicit no-persist mode, creates no chat, combat, effect, or document updates, stops at the first invalid step by default, and can isolate failed steps when continue-on-error is requested.

post.summary: Authenticated native GM encounter creation from existing scene tokens, roster/initiative/start/next/end and durable explicit action/bonus/reaction/movement/ready/interruption decisions.
post.description:
Authenticated native GM encounter creation from existing scene tokens, roster/initiative/start/next/end and durable explicit action/bonus/reaction/movement/ready/interruption decisions. End deletes the combat. Pending interruptions block progress. Legendary/lair/mythic rules require explicit GM ruling and native activity activation for resource use. Supply exact state, durable idempotencyKey and correlationId; uncertain receipts forbid replay.

**Warning:** this operation is destructive/irreversible (see MCP tool annotations).

post.summary: Read exact GM-scoped native dnd5e activity, resources, target revisions and unresolved choices.
post.description: Read exact GM-scoped native dnd5e activity, resources, target revisions and unresolved choices. Read before use; GM state must not be narrated to players without knowledge filtering.

post.summary: Activate native dnd5e activity with native slots/upcasting/charges/uses/concentration, explicit targets and awaited native attack.
post.description: Activate native dnd5e activity with native slots/upcasting/charges/uses/concentration, explicit targets and awaited native attack. Optional damage:true awaits native typed damage/healing linked to original critical/ability/mode/ammunition; typed application and saves require separate explicit decisions. Durable exact-state reservation and turn budgets prevent duplicate spends. Range/reach/cover need per-target human rulings. Explicit template placements persist native geometry; exact owned unlinked world Actor summon profiles use native modifiers/count, with optional native CR/type filters. Held phase ready casts now under native concentration and action budget; phase release binds original confirmed cast and consumes only reaction. Modern attached Regions, compendium imports and linked activities require human native UI. Reconcile uncertain/cancelled results; never retry under a new key.

post.description: Read exact native scene actor health/effects/passives/resources/inventory and Foundry user/character/ownership party roster. GM only. Lookup recipes before applying character actions.

Apply bounded native typed damage/healing/tempHP, checks/death/concentration, stable/unconscious effects, conditions/exhaustion, rests/hit dice, inventory/copies/removal/attunement, currency/XP/maxHP and effect durations. Exact active GM+scene, expected state, durable dedup receipts. Lookup recipe; human rulings required for stabilization/eligibility/group/contested/traps/grapple/shove; transfer is separate receipted copy and source-removal steps. Never replay uncertain rolls/spends.

**Warning:** this operation is destructive/irreversible (see MCP tool annotations).

post.summary: Mirrors the GM's current camera view (position and zoom) onto the digital-tabletops battlemap display (the "TV" Foundry user) — the literal TV2GM action from the module's own scene-control toolbar.
post.description:
Mirrors the GM's current camera view (position and zoom) onto the digital-tabletops battlemap display (the "TV" Foundry user) — the literal TV2GM action from the module's own scene-control toolbar. Advisory only, same caveat as dtt_pan_battlemap: this broadcasts over Foundry's own multiplayer socket (module.digital-tabletops) and does not read back whether the TV client actually applied it, or whether a TV client is even connected, or whether the connected bridge client is actually the GM's own screen — call dtt_get_status first to confirm a TV display is actually connected.

**Optional integration:** available only while module `digital-tabletops` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

get.summary: Convenience composite read for the digital-tabletops integration: whether the module is active, whether a Foundry user named "TV" (case-insensitive, matching dtt.js's own check) exists and is currently online, and the module's four current world settings (namespace "digital-tabletops": hideUI, lockPan, display-width, port-number — also individually reachable via the generic GET/PUT /api/settings/digital-tabletops/:key endpoints).
get.description:
Convenience composite read for the digital-tabletops integration: whether the module is active, whether a Foundry user named "TV" (case-insensitive, matching dtt.js's own check) exists and is currently online, and the module's four current world settings (namespace "digital-tabletops": hideUI, lockPan, display-width, port-number — also individually reachable via the generic GET/PUT /api/settings/digital-tabletops/:key endpoints). Call this before dtt_pan_battlemap/dtt_scale_battlemap_to_physical to confirm a display is actually connected.

**Optional integration:** available only while module `digital-tabletops` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

get.summary: Reads safe Trails package, rules, gameplay, catalog, and capability metadata.
get.description:
Reads safe Trails package, rules, gameplay, catalog, and capability metadata. It does not change Foundry or Trails state.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

get.summary: Reads an authorized, redacted prepared Trails actor summary and readiness findings.
get.description:
Reads an authorized, redacted prepared Trails actor summary and readiness findings. It omits private narrative and retained creation evidence and does not update the Actor.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

get.summary: Reads all authorized embedded Trails items without deduplicating catalog IDs, preserving document, catalog, and owned-instance identities.
get.description:
Reads all authorized embedded Trails items without deduplicating catalog IDs, preserving document, catalog, and owned-instance identities. It does not update inventory.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

get.summary: Lists the four known Trails catalogs with access status and safe entry counts.
get.description:
Lists the four known Trails catalogs with access status and safe entry counts. It does not expose or modify compendium documents.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

get.summary: Reads sanitized canonical entries from one allowlisted, accessible Trails catalog using portable catalog IDs.
get.description:
Reads sanitized canonical entries from one allowlisted, accessible Trails catalog using portable catalog IDs. It does not expose UUIDs as identities or modify the pack.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

get.summary: Evaluates an authorized actor's redacted creation readiness against runtime catalogs and returns findings, unmapped values, and manual boundaries only.
get.description:
Evaluates an authorized actor's redacted creation readiness against runtime catalogs and returns findings, unmapped values, and manual boundaries only. It does not apply repairs or update documents.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

post.summary: Uses the Trails runtime RNG to produce action or skill roll evidence.
post.description:
Uses the Trails runtime RNG to produce action or skill roll evidence. It does not accept caller-supplied die results and does not spend resources, apply effects, update documents, or post chat.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

post.summary: Uses the Trails runtime RNG to preview initiative groups.
post.description:
Uses the Trails runtime RNG to preview initiative groups. Ties remain manual; it does not write Combat initiative, advance rounds, or change documents.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

post.summary: Previews an attack or assault contest from supplied totals.
post.description:
Previews an attack or assault contest from supplied totals. It does not validate target eligibility, spend reaction resources, apply damage, or change Actor state.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

post.summary: Previews an already-adjudicated post-mitigation damage amount and preserves manual-review findings.
post.description:
Previews an already-adjudicated post-mitigation damage amount and preserves manual-review findings. It does not adjudicate armor or update Actors, equipment, conditions, timers, or chat.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

post.summary: Builds a non-authoritative recovery plan from a resource snapshot, explicit eligibility, and optional recorded d10 evidence.
post.description:
Builds a non-authoritative recovery plan from a resource snapshot, explicit eligibility, and optional recorded d10 evidence. Daily claims remain unverified and no recovery is applied.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

get.summary: Calculates level progress from total experience using only the published level 1-50 table.
get.description:
Calculates level progress from total experience using only the published level 1-50 table. It reports table exhaustion and does not extrapolate or update an Actor.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

post.summary: Parses, validates, and previews at most 2 MB of Trails builder JSON, returning issues and unmapped values.
post.description:
Parses, validates, and previews at most 2 MB of Trails builder JSON, returning issues and unmapped values. Even an issue-free preview does not authorize or perform actor creation, reconciliation, or any persistence.

**Optional integration:** available only while system `trails-of-destiny` is active and satisfies its configured version range. When inactive, REST returns a 404 `INTEGRATION_INACTIVE` response and MCP omits this tool from its catalog.

get.summary: Liveness check.
get.description: Unauthenticated liveness check — status/uptime/version. Does not require an API key and is not rate-limited.

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream of Foundry hook events.
get.description: Long-lived Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream of Foundry hook events (Phase 26). Hand-rolled outside the descriptor pattern because SSE needs to hold the connection open rather than return a single JSON response — see server/src/endpoints/events-sse.ts. Not exposed as an MCP tool (MCP has no streaming-response primitive here); the equivalent polling MCP tool is `foundry_get_recent_events`.

200.description: text/event-stream of `{event: string, data: object}` frames.

503.description: No event bus is currently wired up on this server.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Static API key (see server/.env.example's API_KEY, auto-provisioned on first startup).

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key. Provide it via the "x-api-key" header.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests in the current rate-limit window.

ServerError.description: Internal server error (message intentionally generic — see PLAN.md Phase 29).
